decision_matrix.why: the box needs enough clearance for product fit, insert support and packing movement
decision_matrix.buyer_input: product length, width, height, product count, insert space and whether the box must fit a shelf or shipper

decision_matrix.why: weight changes wall direction, flute review and outer carton planning
decision_matrix.buyer_input: single-unit weight, packed set weight, carton quantity and any stacking or palletizing notes

decision_matrix.why: mailer, shipper, display tray and subscription kit boxes solve different jobs
decision_matrix.buyer_input: opening style, closure method, return-flow need, retail display requirement and unboxing goal

decision_matrix.why: flute direction affects folding, edge strength, panel stiffness and print surface choice
decision_matrix.buyer_input: shipping route, print coverage, box size range, product weight and whether fine graphics are needed

decision_matrix.why: corrugated boxes often fail when internal movement is not reviewed
decision_matrix.buyer_input: product placement, divider count, insert material direction and product surface sensitivity

decision_matrix.why: print method depends on panel size, color coverage and surface expectation
decision_matrix.buyer_input: logo files, color direction, outside or inside print area, label panel and artwork status
